gradients.text: bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-500 via-purple-500 to-cyan-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Animated gradient border that travels around the container edge, specifically for CTA buttons.
visual_enhancers.shimmer_card: Cards with stationary shimmer glow border on hover using Framer Motion.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) to prevent pure digital flatness. SVG hexagon patterns.

components.name: NeonCTAButton
components.description: Pill-shaped button with a border that loops around and shines/glows, and speeds up upon being hovered.

components.name: ShimmerCard
components.description: Card with a shiny glow border that stays in one place and shimmers/glows when hovered over.

components.name: AnimatedCounter
components.description: Stat counter starting at 0 and reaching 200+ to indicate websites built.

components.name: WebsiteShowcaseCarousel
components.description: Live website showcase carousel featuring different projects built. Must be highly interactive.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-16 for containers. Deep padding inside cards.

sections.name: Hero
sections.layout: Centered flex layout, massive H1 ('WE BUILD WEBSITES THAT WORK') with text gradient. Neon CTA. Background features floating SVGs (hexagons) or tsparticles.

sections.name: StatsBar
sections.layout: Grid cols-1 md:cols-3. Centered content highlighting '200+ Websites Built' with AnimatedCounter.

sections.name: Services_Bento
sections.layout: Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, gap-8). Cards span different columns. 5 services (Landing Pages, Tradie Sites, Custom Builds, Digital Marketing, Social Media). Include pricing.

sections.name: Portfolio_Carousel
sections.layout: Full width Swiper carousel showcasing website mockups.

sections.name: Blog_Preview
sections.layout: Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8 for Digital Marketing & Social Media blog cards.

sections.name: Contact_Form
sections.layout: Simple, clean form at bottom. Shadcn Form components. Not annoying, high contrast inputs.
sections.behavior: Form submission should trigger a Sonner toast.

sections.name: Security_Privacy_Page
sections.layout: Separate route or modal. Clean typography-focused layout explaining GA4, Meta Pixel, tracking, etc.

motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: All headings must drop down when user scrolls to them (whileInView, y: -20 to 0, opacity 0 to 1).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons speed up looping gradient. Cards glow heavily on hover.

hero_mockup.description: User provided mockup for visual identity

portfolio_item_1.description: Website dashboard analytics screen for showcase

blog_digital_marketing.description: Laptop in dark red neon environment for Digital Marketing/Social Media blog

libraries_and_tools: framer-motion (for scroll reveals, looping glow borders)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pink/cyan on black meets APCA/WCAG ratios.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.

content_guardrails.copy: Be brutally honest about services. Keep form simple. Explicitly mention tracking (GA4, Meta Pixel, Resend) in Privacy page.
content_guardrails.seo: Apply robust metadata, Alt tags for images.
content_guardrails.pricing: Landing page from $499, Tradie site from $999, Custom from $2,499. Price marketing/social media competitively.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: 1. MUST strictly follow dark theme with neon accents. No light theme mode. 2. Do not use generic gradient slop; use crisp glowing borders and layered shadows. 3. No centered layouts for dense text. 4. ALL headings must reveal on scroll. 5. Buttons must have looping animated glow borders. 6. Add a security and privacy page explicitly mentioning GA4, Meta, Bing tracking. 7. Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for overlapping elements; use glassmorphism with blur. 8. Ensure testing data-testid attributes are present everywhere.
